events.description: Frost elected MLA for Vuntut Gwitchin (served to 2021, including as Minister)
events.quote:
That year, I ran for and was elected their 
Member of the Legislative Assembly

events.description: Frost elected Chief of Vuntut Gwitchin
events.quote: In November 2022, I was honoured to be elected Chief of Vuntut Gwitchin

events.description: First Nations-in-Assembly passed Resolution 53/2006 approving the joint complaint
events.quote: On December 7, 2006, the First Nations-in-Assembly

events.description: AFN and Caring Society filed the complaint
events.quote:
the AFN and the Caring Society filed 
the complaint with the CHRT in 2007

events.description: Tribunal issued the Merits Decision, 2016 CHRT 2
events.quote:
on January 26, 
2016, this Tribunal issued its decision on the merits

events.description: Tribunal found Canada non-compliant and ordered consultation (2018 CHRT 4)
events.quote: About two years later on February 1, 2018

events.description: Parties executed the Consultation Protocol establishing the CCCW
events.quote:
On March 2, 2018, the Caring Society, the AFN, the CHRC, Canada, COO, and NAN 
executed a Consultation Protocol

events.description: Parties participated in the CCCW
events.quote:
Between 2018 and 2020, the Caring Society, AFN, the CHRC, Canada, COO, and NAN 
participated in the CCCW.

events.description: Agreement-in-Principle reached after fall 2021 negotiations
events.quote:
This resulted in the December 31, 2021, 
Agreement-in-Principle

events.description: First Nations-in-Assembly passed Resolution 40/2022
events.quote:
on December 8, 2022, the First Nations-in-Assembly passed Resolution 
No. 40/2022

events.description: Caring Society withdrew from the AIP negotiation process to bring a non-compliance motion
events.quote:
in 
December 2023, the Caring Society withdrew from the negotiation process

events.description: Canada, AFN, COO and NAN released the Draft Final Agreement
events.quote: On July 11, 2024, Canada, AFN, COO, and NAN released the Draft Final Agreement

events.description: Frost attended the Yukon consultation sessions on August 1 and 20, 2024
events.quote:
I also attended the only two Draft Final Agreement consultation sessions held in Yukon 
(both virtual) on August 1 and 20, 2024.

events.description: AFN published the Regional Engagement Summary
events.quote: On September 17, 2024, the AFN published a document

events.description: Special Chiefs Assembly rejected the Draft Final Agreement and established the NCCC
events.quote: On October 16-18, 2024, I attended the Special Chiefs Assembly in Calgary, Alberta

events.description: First Nations-in-Assembly passed Resolutions 87-90/2024, approving the NCCC terms of reference in principle
events.quote:
On December 5, 2024, in Resolution No. 89/2024 the First Nations-in-Assembly approved 
the NCCC terms of reference, in principle

events.description: AFN wrote to the Tribunal that it was not in a position to move forward
events.quote: on December 9, 2024, the AFN wrote to the Tribunal

events.description: NCCC began holding videoconference meetings
events.quote: The NCCC began holding meetings by videoconference in December 2024.

events.description: NCCC meeting selected Frost as Chair and appointed Our Children Our Way Society for administration
events.quote:
On January 3, 
2025, the NCCC held a meeting by videoconference.

events.description: Justice Canada wrote that Canada would negotiate only with COO and NAN
events.quote:
On January 6, 2025, legal counsel Paul Vickery wrote on behalf of Department of Justice 
Canada to the AFN

events.description: AFN Regional Chiefs wrote to National Chief Woodhouse on the NCCC's role
events.quote:
on January 15, 2025, the Regional Chiefs of the AFN wrote to AFN National 
Chief Cindy Woodhouse

events.description: NCCC met in person over the week of January 20, 2025 and approved its terms of reference
events.quote:
The NCCC then met in person several times over the 
week of January 20

events.description: AFN Executive Committee directed the AFN to secure funding for the NCCC
events.quote:
[o]n January 21, 2025, the AFN Executive Committee passed a 
motion directing the AFN to secure funding to support the NCCC

events.quote:
On January 22, 
2025, NCCC legal counsel Scott Smith wrote on behalf of NCCC to Mr. Vickery

events.description: Tribunal case management conference asked Canada to meet the NCCC
events.quote: On July 25, 2025, this Tribunal convened a case management conference

events.description: Frost, Bernard and Blackstock wrote to PM Carney and Minister Gull-Masty (the affidavit's text says 2024)
events.quote: On July 28, 2024, having not received a response to my earlier letters

events.description: Frost wrote to the Minister and Deputy Minister following up the Tribunal's request
events.quote: On July 29, 2025

events.description: Minister Gull-Masty wrote to Frost without the requested commitment
events.quote: Minister Gull-Masty wrote to me on July 30, 2025.

events.description: NCCC published its first progress report
events.quote:
on August 1, 
2025, the NCCC published its first progress report

events.description: Frost met Deputy Minister Wilson and Associate Deputy Minister Kovacevic
events.quote:
On August 11, 2025, I met with Deputy Minister Wilson and Associate Deputy 
Minister Michelle Kovacevic

events.description: Frost met Minister Gull-Masty on an introductory basis
events.quote:
On August 18, 2025, Minister Gull-Masty and I met on a preliminary, introductory 
basis.

events.description: Tribunal released 2025 CHRT 80; NCCC began implementing its directions
events.quote:
on August 20, 2025, it delivered its decision reported at 2025 
CHRT 80

events.description: Frost, Bernard and Blackstock requested a follow-up meeting; no response
events.quote:
On August 21, 2025, I—along with Regional Chief Bernard and Dr. Cindy Blackstock—
sent a letter to Minister Gull-Masty

events.description: Canada wrote to the Tribunal seeking clarification and more time
events.quote: On August 29, 2025, Canada wrote to the CHRT in accordance with the above directions.

events.description: First Nations-in-Assembly approved the NCCC Terms of Reference (Draft Resolution 52)
events.quote:
On 
September 3, 2025, the First Nations-in-Assembly formally approved the NCCC’s Terms of 
Reference

events.description: Frost wrote to PM Carney and Minister Gull-Masty addressing Canada's concerns
events.quote: On September 11, 2025, I wrote to Prime Minster Carney

events.description: Frost wrote to Minister Gull-Masty (and again on October 6, 2025)
events.quote: I also wrote to Minister Gull-Masty directly on September 16, 2025, and October 6, 2025

events.description: NCCC set up the 'Engagement: CHRT 80' webpage with backgrounders, chart, forms and toolkit
events.quote: The NCCC set up a webpage entitled “Engagement: CHRT 80.”

events.description: NCCC and Caring Society hosted national webinars on October 3 and 24, 2025
events.quote:
hosted two national webinars on 
October 3 and 24, 2025

events.description: NCCC began distributing engagement documents
events.quote: On October 6, 2025, the NCCC started widely distributing engagement documents
